name: TestRerun
description: Run tests on any agent OS, rerun the failed ones and publish the results. Inputs follow the Visual Studio Test (VSTest@3) task.
author: joaoopereira

inputs.name: testAssemblyVer2
inputs.label: Test files
inputs.helpMarkDown: Test assemblies, projects or solutions to run, one minimatch pattern per line, relative to the search folder. Lines starting with `!` exclude files. Each match runs separately.

inputs.name: searchFolder
inputs.label: Search folder
inputs.helpMarkDown: Folder to search for the test files. Tests also run from this folder.

inputs.name: resultsFolder
inputs.label: Test results folder
inputs.helpMarkDown: Folder for the TRX files of every run. Each test file gets its own subfolder.

inputs.name: testFiltercriteria
inputs.label: Test filter criteria
inputs.helpMarkDown: Run only the tests that match, for example `TestCategory!=Integration`. Reruns combine it with the failed tests.

inputs.name: runSettingsFile
inputs.label: Settings file
inputs.helpMarkDown: A `.runsettings` file.

inputs.name: overrideTestrunParameters
inputs.label: Override test run parameters
inputs.helpMarkDown: Override the `TestRunParameters` of the settings file, for example `-webAppUrl $(appUrl) -userName "Test User"`.

inputs.name: codeCoverageEnabled
inputs.label: Code coverage enabled
inputs.helpMarkDown: Collect code coverage with the `Code Coverage` data collector.

inputs.name: diagnosticsEnabled
inputs.label: Collect advanced diagnostics in case of catastrophic failures
inputs.helpMarkDown: Run in blame mode, to find the test that crashes the test host.

inputs.name: otherConsoleOptions
inputs.label: Other console options
inputs.helpMarkDown: Other [test-rerun options](https://joaoopereira.github.io/dotnet-test-rerun/usage), quoted as in a shell, for example `--framework net8.0 --delay 5`.

inputs.name: rerunFailedTests
inputs.label: Rerun failed tests
inputs.helpMarkDown: Rerun the tests that failed until they pass or the maximum number of attempts is reached.

inputs.name: rerunType
inputs.label: Do not rerun if test failures exceed specified threshold
inputs.helpMarkDown: Skip the reruns when too many tests failed in the first run, by percentage or by count.

inputs.name: rerunFailedThreshold
inputs.label: % failure
inputs.helpMarkDown: Do not rerun when more than this percentage of the tests failed. `-1` means no limit.

inputs.name: rerunFailedTestCasesMaxLimit
inputs.label: # of failed tests
inputs.helpMarkDown: Do not rerun when more than this number of tests failed. `-1` means no limit.

inputs.name: rerunMaxAttempts
inputs.label: Maximum # of attempts
inputs.helpMarkDown: Maximum number of reruns after the first run.

inputs.name: testRunTitle
inputs.label: Test run title
inputs.helpMarkDown: Title of the published test run.

inputs.name: platform
inputs.label: Build platform
inputs.helpMarkDown: Build platform to report the tests against, for example `$(BuildPlatform)`.

inputs.name: configuration
inputs.label: Build configuration
inputs.helpMarkDown: Build configuration to report the tests against, for example `$(BuildConfiguration)`.

inputs.name: customLoggerConfig
inputs.label: Test logger
inputs.helpMarkDown: An extra logger, for example `junit;LogFileName={assembly}.junit.xml`. A TRX logger is always added.

inputs.name: publishRunAttachments
inputs.label: Upload test attachments
inputs.helpMarkDown: Upload the files attached to the test run.

inputs.name: donotPublishTestResults
inputs.label: Disable publishing test results
inputs.helpMarkDown: Do not publish the TRX files to the Tests tab.

inputs.name: failOnMinTestsNotRun
inputs.label: Fail the task if a minimum number of tests are not run
inputs.helpMarkDown: Fail when fewer distinct tests than the minimum ran.

inputs.name: minimumExpectedTests
inputs.label: Minimum # of tests
inputs.helpMarkDown: Minimum number of distinct tests that must run.

inputs.name: version
inputs.label: dotnet-test-rerun version
inputs.helpMarkDown: Tool version to install. Empty installs the latest release on every run; a pinned version is cached on the agent.

outputVariables.name: resultsDirectory
outputVariables.description: Folder that holds the TRX files of every run.
